title: Illustrative abstraction caller inventory
method: Twelve fictional callers: seven use the default, three use a special rounding flag, and two bypass behaviour after calling. Counts prompt inspection; exceptions alone do not prove an abstraction is wrong.
alt: Illustrative abstraction caller inventory. Default path: 7 callers; Special rounding flag: 3 callers; Post-call bypass: 2 callers. Illustrative inputs.
